title: Can French Bulldogs Be Left Alone? How Long, and Separation Anxiety
seoTitle: Can French Bulldogs Be Left Alone? How Long Is OK
description: Can French Bulldogs be left alone? How many hours is OK, what to do if you work 8-hour days, separation anxiety signs and how to train your Frenchie.
primaryKeyword: can french bulldogs be left alone
secondaryKeywords: how long can french bulldogs be left alone
can french bulldogs be left alone for 8 hours
do french bulldogs bark when left alone

faq.q: How long can French Bulldogs be left alone?
faq.a: UK welfare groups including the RSPCA, PDSA and Dogs Trust advise no more than about 4 hours at a time on a regular basis for an adult dog. Puppies should be left for much less.

faq.q: Can French Bulldogs be left alone for 8 hours?
faq.a: Not as a regular routine. If you work full days away from home, arrange a midday visit from a family member, neighbor or dog walker, or use a trusted daycare.

faq.q: Do French Bulldogs have separation anxiety?
faq.a: Many struggle when left alone, and the breed club says they do not do well alone for long periods. Signs include chewing near doors, barking or howling, accidents indoors, drooling and refusing food while you are out.

faq.q: Do French Bulldogs bark when left alone?
faq.a: The AKC says Frenchies are not a particularly vocal breed, so a lot of barking or howling while you are out can be a sign of distress. A video of the first 30 to 60 minutes after you leave helps you find out.

faq.q: How do I leave my French Bulldog alone for the first time?
faq.a: Start with absences of seconds or minutes, skip big goodbyes and greetings, and add time slowly while your dog stays calm. A stuffed food toy and a short walk before you go also help.
